'''Kessinnamon rolls''' were served as a breakfast side at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="dex" /> at some point prior to the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery's]] destruction during the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]].<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' states that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places ''Underworld'' around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Dex's Diner was destroyed in either 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] or 18 BBY.</ref> The [[Bread/Legends|rolls]], made with [[Kessinnamon]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]], could be purchased for 3.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kessinnamon rolls were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="dex" />
